:::{#exr-expected-error-epe}
#### The expected generalization error, covariate value by covariate value

Let $g$ be a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure),
and let the random [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$ of $n$ observations
be independent of the new observation $(X_0, Y_0)$.
Show that the [expected generalization error](#def-expected-generalization-error)
is the mean of the [expected squared prediction error at $x$](#def-epe)
over the distribution of $X_0$:

$$
\expgenerr{n} = \E{\epe{g}{n}{X_0}}.
$$

:::
